section_summary.extract_value: This is Fig. 1, a conceptual affect regulation model adapted from Cash (2011) that illustrates the theoretical pathways linking body image threat examples, social/body comparison processes, body dissatisfaction, and positive body image coping strategies (including body appreciation) in Black older adolescent females, with BMI proposed as a moderator. No empirical study data, sample characteristics, or correlation coefficients are presented in this figure.
section_summary.evidence_source: Figure 1 caption and diagram content from J.B. Webb et al. / Body Image 11 (2014) 426–437, page 429.
